prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. High-fidelity flat desktop application screenshot, 1440×1000 composition, crisp legible English UI text in Geist sans-serif. Edit the supplied current Workbench screenshot into a proposed state. Input image is the incumbent visual and composition reference, not content to reproduce blindly. Keep restrained T3code-like continuous chat, dark warm charcoal (#201e22) opaque background, slightly lighter composer (#28262b), pale near-white text, muted grey metadata, restrained lavender signature/selection only. Preserve // Workbench identity, company CCC Intelligent Solutions · CCCS, subdued user bubble, quiet unboxed assistant prose, compact bottom anchored composer, generous reading measure, and independent floating context card OPEN at upper right. Card has Plan, Outputs, Sources; it belongs to the dossier, never attach references to messages. No permanent right rail; floating card does not overlap main reading column. Remove the gallery's top preview/debug toolbar completely. In the top app header show // Workbench, company label, discreet 'Illustrative' disclosure and context icon. No marketing, gradients on background, glass decoration, giant headings, browser chrome, laptop frame, purple-filled cards or unrelated sidebars. Main chat column left-center about 740px wide; right floating card about 300px. Use realistic concise exact English copy below. Small icons drawn as consistent thin line icons. Copy controls are icon-only and timestamp appears beside copy on hovered message. This is a design proposal image, not a claim of actual research or real evidence. Preserve the important launch treatment: rounded pale subtly shaded 'Start research →' button for explicit commitment, visually stronger than secondary controls.
STATE 4: A TWO-PANEL BEFORE/AFTER COMPARISON OF ONE ASSISTANT TURN. Wide high-resolution presentation board with two equally sized application screenshot panels side by side, each a complete desktop chat UI. Maintain ample text legibility. A discreet label OUTSIDE each screenshot: left "While working", right "After the turn". Everything inside the app is English.
Use the reference only for Workbench materials/identity, not its framing content. Remove all pending research/framing forms, scope chips and Start research buttons. Both screenshots show the SAME conversation and same relative header, composer and floating context positions. Right context card remains floating upper-right OPEN in both screenshots, narrow enough to leave reading column clear. Use compact card typography. Mark each app "Illustrative". No giant icons, cards around assistant prose, browser frame, purple backgrounds, provider/model/agent logos or hidden chain-of-thought.

Both screenshots: user bubble "What could make CCC difficult to replace?" close to top.
LEFT, RUNNING TURN:
Assistant public commentary directly in thread: "I'll compare the retained material on integrations and coordination."
Then two clearly separate thin operation entries INLINE in the thread, not a collapsed group:
check icon "Read the retained investor presentation" with muted subline "Coordination and network participation".
small circular running indicator "Compare switching dependencies" with muted subline "Checking what is contractual and what is operational".
Then a partially generated readable assistant answer: "The useful distinction is between replacing a software module and replacing the coordination around it." A subtle caret after the unfinished next line "The remaining question is".
Keep these in chronological order so the UI feels like continuous work, with no fake user questionnaire.
Above composer a very quiet status line "Comparing retained material" and small text "Stop response". This clearly refers to the reply, not pausing research. Bottom composer compact, placeholder "Message Workbench…".
Left floating card sections: Plan "Photo-led claims"; Sources "Investor day deck"; Work "Comparing dependencies" with running indicator.
Do NOT put a completed-work summary at the beginning while running.

RIGHT, SAME TURN FINISHED:
At the beginning of this assistant turn, above final prose, one compact collapsed summary row with chevron: "Worked for 18s · 2 operations". Below it, FINAL answer remains entirely visible in ordinary Markdown-like typography, no activity card, no duplicate intermediate prose.
Answer heading "Replacing software is not the same as replacing coordination".
Paragraph "The illustrative material points to two different dependencies:"
Two bullets:
"Integrations: exchanging data inside established workflows."
"Coordination: connecting insurers and repairers around the same claim."
Then a small clean two-column table with header "What to test" / "Why it matters" and rows "Switching effort" / "Can integrations be rebuilt?" and "Decision rights" / "Who can redirect the work?".
Final short paragraph with bold lead "Limit:" followed by "This example does not establish switching costs or pricing power."
Timestamp and copy ICON under final answer, no Copy text button.
No numbered citations attached to this message; dossier references stay in floating card.
No active status strip or Stop control after finished. Same compact bottom composer.
Right context card Work section now "2 operations complete", Sources unchanged. Never label the entire research dossier complete merely because the response finished. Outputs can say "No retained output".
The visual comparison must make active continuous operations versus terminal grouped operations unmistakable. No fake results presented as factual evidence: label illustrative prominently and retain limit sentence.
purpose: One discussed proposal, illustrated across its states; not competing compositions
